tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text:
In the electrolytic refining of blister copper, the total number of main impurities, from the following, removed as anode mud is ___________ .
Pb, Sb, Se, Te, Ru, Ag, Au and Pt

solution.text: Impurities from the blister copper deposit as anode mud which contains antimony, selenium, tellurium, silver, gold and platinum.
